name: Golden Dunes General Trading
headline: Frozen Meat & Seafood Suppliers Dubai
lede: Golden Dunes supplies premium frozen meat, seafood, poultry and dumplings across Dubai and UAE. Wholesale, import and export services available.
about: WE ARE UNWAVERING TO QUALITY!! Customer satisfaction is of fundamental importance to us. Our skilled, devoted team works closely with all our clients as a vital part of our daily activity. We believe in the power of Good Quality Food, Service and Timely Delivery – to bring people together and make moments special.

Golden Dunes is an Organization Structured to have the flexibility and versatility to keep ahead of local competition while keeping pace with the ever-evolving global business scenario. It is strategically positioned in the commercial hub of the Middle East, Dubai, UAE.
